calibration.scope: Empirical-null-centered, leave-one-out predictive scores; fixed input pixel mask.

rerun_provenance.source_snapshot_scope: Exact pre-guard execution snapshots are retained in the internal rerun directory; later changes to filenames/docstrings do not alter the numerical objective
rerun_provenance.likelihood_pixel_rule: All finite residuals at the fixed input mask; any numerical model failure is rejected

nominal_sigmas_scope: Observed displacement from empirical null mean divided by null standard deviation; not a Gaussian tail claim.
